name: CAP S.A.
summary: CAP S.A. engages in iron mining, industrial, and infrastructure businesses in Chile, Peru, Argentina, and internationally. The company is involved in extraction of iron ore and its subsequent processing, internal, and external sales. It also develops and exploits mining deposits; provides geological and mining research, engineering, mechanical and industrial maintenance, and construction and earthmoving services; and produces iron ore and pellets.
